subject: What the control bar exposes, and which attribute carries each reading
question: Can tempo, meter, key and the playhead position be read from the control bar, and from which attribute?

reverify.command: Walk the arrange window to depth 8 collecting role, AXDescription, AXValue and AXValueDescription for every element whose description names a transport control (재생/정지/녹음/위치/템포/박자/조표/사이클/메트로놈 or their English equivalents).
reverify.expected: tempo reads as a number on an AXSlider; meter and key read as popup values; the playhead position group has no value while the playhead thumbnail's AXValueDescription carries the bar

method: Read every attribute on each named control rather than only AXValue, because the Event List had already shown that the true reading sits on a different attribute per column. Doing the same here is what separated the position group from the thumbnail.

observations.note: the raw value is an opaque fixed-point number; the description is the reading
these are the per-track arm buttons in the header rail, not a control-bar control

conclusion: Tempo, meter and key are readable directly and honestly: the tempo AXSlider carries 120.0 as its value with a matching description, and the meter and key popups carry 4/4 and C 메이저. The playhead is the exception and the reason to read every attribute rather than AXValue alone -- the element described 재생헤드 위치 is an AXGroup with no value at all, while the playhead thumbnail is an AXValueIndicator whose AXValue is an opaque fixed-point number and whose AXValueDescription reads 5 마디. So the position exists on the surface and is not where its name suggests, and a reader that takes AXValue from the named element gets nothing while one that takes AXValue from the indicator gets a number that is not a bar. This is the same split already recorded for the Event List velocity column: the attribute that carries the truth differs per control, and only reading both tells you which.
limits: One project, ko-KR, transport stopped. Nothing here was measured while playing, so whether the thumbnail description updates live or only on settle is unknown.
Reading only. No write to tempo, meter, key or position was attempted, and the tempo slider being readable says nothing about it being settable — Controls-view sliders report success and do not move.
The 녹음 활성화 checkboxes are track-header arm buttons that matched the name filter; they are listed for completeness and are a different surface.
Bar 5 was wherever the playhead happened to sit; the reading was not cross-checked against a second source of the position.
